decision: defined done as: stats tests green against independent reference values, build under 150 KB of JS, verify skill launch and doctor pass, all 5 feature journeys run with evidence
why: the PRD numbers are the product, so they need a check that does not reuse the app's own code

decision: production deploy stays out of this run
why: deploy is irreversible and outward-facing, the owner did not ask for it

decision: wrote the engine type contract myself before any delegate starts
why: every stream (engine, worker, UI) reads the same shapes, so they can work in parallel without guessing

decision: harness reuses the cf OAuth session for wrangler
why: wrangler is not logged in and the AI binding is remote even in dev; launch failed without it
evidence: commit 2ced25c, ctl launch + doctor all PASS

decision: split the build into three owners: engine, worker, UI, each in its own worktree; engine and worker run now, UI starts after the engine lands
why: engine and worker touch disjoint files; the UI needs real engine numbers to prove its journeys, so it waits instead of building against stubs

decision: engine to Opus 5.5 high, worker to GPT-6.1-Sol high
why: pstack config: hardest tasks on Opus, feature work on GPT-6.1-Sol; the statistics are the subtle part

decision: engine must ship a stdlib-only Python generator of reference values and test against it
why: tests that reuse the engine's own math can't catch a wrong formula

decision: opened a fourth stream for the teaching and finding texts, Opus on prose
why: the texts are prose with a correctness bar and touch only new files under src/i18n/content
